scope: Purchased building persistence and construction resume

responseFields.id: Allocated server SID; stock calls getUnit(cid).setSid(id)

stockEvidence: BuildingBuilder._update removes timer at expiry without completing construction

persistence.source: Resolve gc.buildings CID keys via G_UnitManager.getUnit
persistence.include: Existing records plus purchased buildings with assigned SID and state != 0
persistence.resume: Elapsed jobs receive completion; remaining jobs get a timer guarded by pending ticket identity

sidAllocation: Count numeric and numeric-string SIDs; check durable records and pending tickets. Live lookup only reserves an exact SID match, because an unmapped SID can return units.undefined (player). See building-confirm-freeze.json.
purchaseTarget: Use request cid before activeBuilder; validate construction state and matching typeid; missing or mismatched target must not reassign another unit
runtime: Instance 1: 85 buildings preserved; 8 existing construction walls completed on login; new purchase scenario awaits user retest
